description: Empirical evaluation of staging, backup, commit, failure rollback, existing file restoration, and cleanup
terminology_statement: The implementation provides prevalidated multi-file staging with rollback on detected commit failure. This guarantees pre-mutation safety, backup restoration of modified files, and cleanup of newly created files upon detected exceptions, without claiming universal low-level operating system atomic transaction guarantees.
